text:
rachel: quick check — where do i find per-model SM utilization, gpu mem pressure, and kv-cache hit/eviction panels + related traces for the last 6h? want to propose a small alert tune: batch_size spike -> mem churn -> evictions. who owns these panels?

maya: here are the dashboards i usually use: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/gpu-telemetry (panelId=37 for SM%, panelId=88 for GPU mem) and https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kvcache/kv-health (panelId=14 hitrate, panelId=19 evictions).

maya: quick prom query for per-model SM%: `avg(rate(sm_utilization_gpu_seconds_total[5m])) by (model)` — throw that into the panel variable `model` and you can compare.

jonathan: traces: use Tempo -> https://tempo.redwood.ai/search with `tag=model:<model-name>` or search logs for `trace_id` in `requests` index and open in Tempo. If you want direct example: https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/8a1f2c...

jonathan: suggestion for alerting: current eviction-rate alert triggers at `eviction_rate > 0.05` for 5m. i'd suggest bumping to `0.08` and add a correlated check for `avg_over_time(batch_size[5m]) > 6` to avoid noisy alerts from short-lived spikes. e.g. rule: `eviction_rate > 0.08 and avg_over_time(batch_size[5m]) > 6`

sre-bot: incidentbot: alert kvcache_evictions firing for pool=smem-prod (count=12) — auto-tagging #eng-oncall. :rotating_light:

liam: i can take the alert PR and the panel ownership update. will open a PR to alert-rules repo in ~30m and add owners to the dashboard metadata. ok to proceed?

rachel: yes please — thanks liam. can you also add a short note in the runbook about how to rollback the change if we see regression? :+1:

maya: runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/gpu-kvcache-memory. paste from runbook for quick rollback: ```1) revert alert rule in infra/alerts/kv-evictions.yaml 2) reduce batch_cap to 4 via /ops/api/pools/{pool}/config 3) monitor kv_eviction_rate and sm_mem_pressure for 10m```

jonathan: fyi i dug into yesterday's spike — eviction bursts lined up with batch_size jumps from ~3 -> ~12 for a subset of models. short-term mitigation: cap per-request batching at 8 and add jitter. longer-term: kv cache sizing per model.

liam: got it. opening PR now, will cc @rachel @maya and ping #eng-oncall when merged. estimated window: 10–15m to merge + rollout.

rachel: perfect — appreciate it. if anyone spots related errors in logs use `service=requests` and filter `kvcache.eviction=true` then paste trace ids here.

monitoring-bot: note: dashboard abcd1234 updated — new variable `model` added by maya.

rachel: thanks all :raised_hands:
